1.title: Here’s the latest.
1.summary: President Xi Jinping’s first visit to the White House in a decade comes as President Trump continues his unexpected turn from a hard line on China.

2.title: In San Francisco, It’s a Good Time to Be a Satirist
2.summary: Artificial intelligence companies are becoming pervasive in the city, and a humorist finds them ripe for mocking.

3.title: South Asians, a ‘Model Minority,’ Face Surging Racism in America
3.summary: Social media posts, including from the Department of Homeland Security and a Texas Republican candidate, have helped stir fear among people of South Asian heritage.

4.title: U.N. Live Updates: Abbas Criticizes Israeli Attacks and Failure of Gaza Peace Plan
4.summary: The Palestinian leader, Mahmoud Abbas, condemned settler violence in the West Bank, saying, ‘We will not leave our homeland.’ Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel will take the stage later today, weeks before pivotal elections at home.

5.title: Forced Eviction of 87-Year-Old Woman Spurs Outrage in Spain
5.summary: Demonstrations broke out across the country over the woman’s eviction in Madrid, putting rising rents and affordability at the top of the political conversation.

6.title: White House 'repeatedly violated' court order to restore press access, say media outlets
6.summary: Employees from CNN, Politico and MS Now reported being denied entry, with some having passes confiscated.
